state_analysis: The analysis_report.txt has been created. Now I need to create the optimized_logrotate.conf file and the rotation_summary.csv file.
explanation: Creating the optimized logrotate configuration file with proper rotation schedules, compression, and retention policies for all log files.

commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/optimized_logrotate.conf << 'EOF'
# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated by Log Rotation Analyzer
# Implements best practices for disk space management and compliance

# Application Log - High growth rate, 30-day retention
/var/log/samples/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root root
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 50M
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/killall -HUP rsyslogd 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Access Log - Very high growth rate (45.7 MB/day), 14-day retention
/var/log/samples/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 100M
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/killall -HUP nginx 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Error Log - Critical importance, 60-day retention for compliance
/var/log/samples/error.log {
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 25M
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/killall -HUP nginx 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# System Log - Low growth rate, 90-day retention
/var/log/samples/system.log {
    weekly
    rotate 12
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root adm
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 50M
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/killall -HUP rsyslogd 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Debug Log - Low importance, 7-day retention
/var/log/samples/debug.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 20M
    # Debug logs can be removed quickly to save space
}
EOF
